Érica, today is my last day at Biodelta. I leave on Saturday.
Oh, Mark! We're going to miss you. This is a small gift for you.
A gift? Thank you! Oh, it's a painting of Ibirapuera Park!
Yes, I painted it. It's a souvenir of the most beautiful place in São Paulo.
It's beautiful. It's the best gift of my trip!
So, tell me. Is São Paulo better than Boston?
Boston is quieter and smaller. But here the food is better, and the people are friendlier!
Then you should come back next year. You could visit Rio, too.
Good idea! And you should visit Boston. You could stay with my family.
Maybe in July! Goodbye, Mark, and have a good trip.

Hi, Érica. It's Mark. I'm at Guarulhos Airport now. Thank you again for the gift! The painting is in my suitcase, and it's my favorite souvenir. São Paulo is the biggest city of my life, and this was the best trip, too. Boston is quieter, but I'm going to miss the food and the people at Biodelta. And you should send me photos of the park! Goodbye for now, and see you in Boston!

Good morning, and welcome to City Top Three. Today: the best souvenirs from São Paulo. Number three is coffee. It's cheaper here than in many countries, and it's delicious. Number two is a football T-shirt. It's the most popular souvenir with tourists. And number one is a small painting from a local artist. It's more expensive than a T-shirt, but it's special. My advice? You could buy a painting at the fair in Benedito Calixto Square, in Pinheiros, on Saturday. You should go early, because it's very crowded. Have a good trip!
